description: Current deterministic TypeScript exports executed with Node Playwright against unchanged demo twins.

cases.title: Double-clicking "Place order" sends the request twice
Switching to Preview and back to Write discards the typed release notes
Double activation of Publish sends duplicate publish requests
Closing the signup dialog with Close does not return focus to the opener
Failed signup wipes the typed email and name instead of preserving them
